cond_0001.intro:
The Clinical Research Assistant performs a variety of research, data and clerical duties of a routine and technical nature to support the conduct of clinical research under the direction of a senior research team member. The Research Assistant will develop a progressive functional knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCP), Office of Human Research Protections (OHRP) regulations and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations. In this role, the Clinical Research Assistant completes tasks including identifying eligible participants under the supervision of a senior research team member, preparing necessary documents, equipment, supplies, etc. For research visits and conducting and documenting visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for minimal risk studies or for other studies.
The [Company name masked] is looking for an individual for a clinical research assistant position. This position will provide support to several ongoing studies to address inequities in emergency department care.
The successful candidate will support the day-to-day operations of the study, including administrative duties, screening, enrollment, and recruitment of research participants, and data collection. The assistant will be able to work as part of a highly collaborative team dedicated to improving care in the emergency department.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Responsible Conduct of Research
Consistently demonstrates adherence to the standards for the responsible conduct of research.
Plans, conducts and manages research projects within federal and institutional regulations and policies under the direction of the principal investigator.
Stays informed of and adheres to institutional policies and federal regulations (e.g. Titles 21 and 45 of the Code of Federal Regulations) and guidance (International Counsel on Harmonization) regarding human subjects research and use of protected health information.
Uses research funds and resources appropriately.
Maintains confidentiality of data as required.
Meets all annual job-related training and compliance requirements.
Research Administration
Maintains knowledge and comprehension of assigned research protocols, including study procedures, timelines and eligibility.
Accurately creates, completes, maintains and organizes study documents.
Accounts for study materials, including participant lists and visit logs, regulatory binders, case report forms, laboratory kits, investigational product(s) and participation incentives.
Uses and accounts for research funds and resources at performance level, including reconciling research subject billing if assigned.
Attends study meetings, which could include overnight travel, as requested by principal investigator.
Works well with other members of the research team and seeks and provides input when appropriate.
Participant Enrollment
Adheres to the IRB-approved recruitment plan.
Identifies participants that meet eligibility requirements under the supervision of a senior research team member.
Screens subjects for eligibility per the protocol and institutional policies.
Communicates effectively and provides information to a diverse, vulnerable subject population in accordance with institutional policies.
Interacts with study participants and/or legally authorized representatives (LARs) to communicate study purpose and participation details and to assess participation interest.
Engages participants/LARs in the informed consent process according to institutional policies.
Follows procedures for documenting participant incentive distribution.
Study Management
Plans, conducts and manages research activities in accordance with federal regulations and guidance documents and sponsor and institutional policies under the direction of a senior study team member.
Conducts and documents visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments and SOPs for minimal risk studies or for other studies under direction.
Completes accurate IRB submissions within institutional timeframes.
Records participant visits in the appropriate tracking system.
Anticipates study needs and subject caseload in order to meet organizational objectives and deadlines in a timely manner.
Data Collection
Ensures data is collected as required by protocol and in accordance with research data principles (ALCOAC: Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate and Complete).
Ensures that queries are resolved within sponsor and institutional timelines.
Plans and performs research specimen collection, labeling and storage/shipping if assigned; maintains accurate sample accountability/chain of custody documentation.
Ensures secure storage of study documents and assists in maintaining regulatory documents per sponsor and institutional requirements.
Anticipate and responds to customer needs; follows up until needs are met.
Teamwork/Communication
Demonstrate collaborative and respectful behavior.
Partner with all team members to achieve goals.
Receptive to others' ideas and opinions.
Performance Improvement/Problem-solving
Contribute to a positive work environment.
Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to change.
Identify opportunities to improve clinical and administrative processes.
Make appropriate decisions, using sound judgment.
Cost Management/Financial Responsibility
Use resources efficiently.
Search for less costly ways of doing things.
Safety
Speak up when team members appear to exhibit unsafe behavior or performance.
Continuously validate and verify information needed for decision making or documentation.
Stop in the face of uncertainty and takes time to resolve the situation.
Demonstrate accurate, clear and timely verbal and written communication.
Actively promote safety for patients, families, visitors and co-workers.
Attend carefully to important details - practicing Stop, Think, Act and Review in order to self-check behavior and performance.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) in a science, technical, health-related field or another applicable discipline.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Organizational skills with attention to detail.
Ability to work closely with a diverse team including stakeholders, investigators, and research staff.
Preferred Requirements
Experience working in a medical or scientific research setting.
Commitment to improving healthcare delivery and outcomes.

cond_0018.intro:
We are looking for a Clinical Research Assistant to join our team at [Company name masked]. The Clinical Research Assistant supports the conduct of clinical research under the direction of a senior research team member, carrying out research, data, and clerical duties of a routine and technical nature. The role involves developing working knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCP), Office of Human Research Protections (OHRP) regulations, and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations.
The Addressing Disparities Through Advocacy, Prevention, and Technology (ADAPT) Research Lab is seeking a candidate for this position to contribute to several ongoing studies addressing inequities in emergency department care.
The successful candidate will support the day-to-day operations of the study, including administrative duties, screening, enrollment, and recruitment of research participants, and data collection. The assistant will work as part of a collaborative team dedicated to improving care in the emergency department.
cond_0018.responsibilities:
Responsible Conduct of Research
Consistently demonstrates adherence to the standards for the responsible conduct of research.
Coordinates research projects within federal and institutional regulations and policies under the direction of the principal investigator.
Stays informed of and adheres to institutional policies and federal regulations (e.g. Titles 21 and 45 of the Code of Federal Regulations) and guidance (International Counsel on Harmonization) regarding human subjects research and use of protected health information.
Uses research funds and resources appropriately.
Maintains confidentiality of data as required.
Meets all annual job-related training and compliance requirements.
Research Administration
Maintains knowledge and comprehension of assigned research protocols, including study procedures, timelines and eligibility.
Accurately creates, completes, maintains and organizes study documents.
Accounts for study materials, including participant lists and visit logs, regulatory binders, case report forms, laboratory kits, investigational product(s) and participation incentives.
Uses and accounts for research funds and resources at performance level, including reconciling research subject billing if assigned.
Attends study meetings, which could include overnight travel, as requested by principal investigator.
Works well with other members of the research team and seeks and provides input when appropriate.
Participant Enrollment
Adheres to the IRB-approved recruitment plan.
Helps identify participants that meet eligibility requirements under the supervision of a senior research team member.
Screens subjects for eligibility per the protocol and institutional policies.
Communicates effectively and provides information to a diverse, vulnerable subject population in accordance with institutional policies.
Coordinates with study participants and/or legally authorized representatives (LARs) to communicate study purpose and participation details and to assess participation interest.
Engages participants/LARs in the informed consent process according to institutional policies.
Follows procedures for documenting participant incentive distribution.
Study Management
Supports research activities in accordance with federal regulations and guidance documents and sponsor and institutional policies under the direction of a senior study team member.
Conducts and documents visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments and SOPs for minimal risk studies or for other studies under direction.
Completes accurate IRB submissions within institutional timeframes.
Records participant visits in the appropriate tracking system.
Coordinates with the team to anticipate study needs and subject caseload in order to meet organizational objectives and deadlines in a timely manner.
Data Collection
Ensures data is collected as required by protocol and in accordance with research data principles (ALCOAC: Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate and Complete).
Ensures that queries are resolved within sponsor and institutional timelines.
Plans and performs research specimen collection, labeling and storage/shipping if assigned; maintains accurate sample accountability/chain of custody documentation.
Ensures secure storage of study documents and assists in maintaining regulatory documents per sponsor and institutional requirements.
Anticipates and responds to customer needs; follows up until needs are met.
Teamwork/Communication
Demonstrate collaborative and respectful behavior.
Partner with all team members to achieve goals.
Receptive to others' ideas and opinions.
Performance Improvement/Problem-solving
Contribute to a positive work environment.
Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to change.
Identify opportunities to improve clinical and administrative processes.
Make appropriate decisions, using sound judgment.
Cost Management/Financial Responsibility
Use resources efficiently.
Search for less costly ways of doing things.
Safety
Speak up when team members appear to exhibit unsafe behavior or performance.
Continuously validate and verify information needed for decision making or documentation.
Stop in the face of uncertainty and takes time to resolve the situation.
Demonstrate accurate, clear and timely verbal and written communication.
Actively promote safety for patients, families, visitors and co-workers.
Attend carefully to important details - practicing Stop, Think, Act and Review in order to self-check behavior and performance.
cond_0018.requirements:
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Organizational skills with attention to detail.
Ability to work closely with a diverse team including stakeholders, investigators, and research staff.
Commitment to improving healthcare delivery and outcomes.
Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) in a science, technical, health-related field or another applicable discipline.
Experience working in a medical or scientific research setting.

The Research Assistant will develop a progressive functional knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCP), Office of Human Research Protections (OHRP) regulations and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations. In this role, the Clinical Research Assistant completes tasks including identifying eligible participants under the supervision of a senior research team member, preparing necessary documents, equipment, supplies, etc. For research visits and conducting and documenting visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for minimal risk studies or for other studies.
[Company name masked] is looking for an enthusiastic and motivated individual for a clinical research assistant position. This position will provide support to several ongoing studies to address inequities in emergency department care.
The successful candidate will bring a passion for the work and will support the day-to-day operations of the study, including administrative duties, screening, enrollment, and recruitment of research participants, and data collection. The assistant will be able to work as part of a highly collaborative team dedicated to improving care in the emergency department. Most people become stronger in this kind of clinical research work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0041.responsibilities:
Responsible Conduct of Research
Consistently demonstrates adherence to the standards for the responsible conduct of research.
Plans, conducts and manages research projects within federal and institutional regulations and policies under the direction of the principal investigator.
Stays informed of and adheres to institutional policies and federal regulations (e.g. Titles 21 and 45 of the Code of Federal Regulations) and guidance (International Counsel on Harmonization) regarding human subjects research and use of protected health information.
Uses research funds and resources appropriately.
Maintains confidentiality of data as required.
Meets all annual job-related training and compliance requirements.
Research Administration
Maintains knowledge and comprehension of assigned research protocols, including study procedures, timelines and eligibility.
Accurately creates, completes, maintains and organizes study documents.
Accounts for study materials, including participant lists and visit logs, regulatory binders, case report forms, laboratory kits, investigational product(s) and participation incentives.
Uses and accounts for research funds and resources at performance level, including reconciling research subject billing if assigned.
Attends study meetings, which could include overnight travel, as requested by principal investigator.
Works well with other members of the research team and seeks and provides input when appropriate.
Participant Enrollment
Adheres to the IRB-approved recruitment plan.
Identifies participants that meet eligibility requirements under the supervision of a senior research team member.
Screens subjects for eligibility per the protocol and institutional policies.
Communicates effectively and provides information to a diverse, vulnerable subject population in accordance with institutional policies.
Interacts with study participants and/or legally authorized representatives (LARs) to communicate study purpose and participation details and to assess participation interest.
Engages participants/LARs in the informed consent process according to institutional policies.
Follows procedures for documenting participant incentive distribution.
Study Management
Plans, conducts and manages research activities in accordance with federal regulations and guidance documents and sponsor and institutional policies under the direction of a senior study team member.
Conducts and documents visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments and SOPs for minimal risk studies or for other studies under direction.
Completes accurate IRB submissions within institutional timeframes.
Records participant visits in the appropriate tracking system.
Anticipates study needs and subject caseload in order to meet organizational objectives and deadlines in a timely manner.
Data Collection
Ensures data is collected as required by protocol and in accordance with research data principles (ALCOAC: Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate and Complete).
Ensures that queries are resolved within sponsor and institutional timelines.
Plans and performs research specimen collection, labeling and storage/shipping if assigned; maintains accurate sample accountability/chain of custody documentation.
Ensures secure storage of study documents and assists in maintaining regulatory documents per sponsor and institutional requirements.
Anticipate and responds to customer needs; follows up until needs are met
Teamwork/Communication
Demonstrate collaborative and respectful behavior
Partner with all team members to achieve goals
Receptive to others' ideas and opinions
Performance Improvement/Problem-solving
Contribute to a positive work environment
Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to change
Identify opportunities to improve clinical and administrative processes
Make appropriate decisions, using sound judgment

Use resources efficiently
Search for less costly ways of doing things
Safety
Speak up when team members appear to exhibit unsafe behavior or performance
Continuously validate and verify information needed for decision making or documentation
Stop in the face of uncertainty and takes time to resolve the situation
Demonstrate accurate, clear and timely verbal and written communication
Actively promote safety for patients, families, visitors and co-workers
Attend carefully to important details - practicing Stop, Think, Act and Review in order to self-check behavior and performance

Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) in a science, technical, health-related field or another applicable discipline
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Organizational skills with attention to detail
Ability to work closely with a diverse team including stakeholders, investigators, and research staff

Experience working in a medical or scientific research setting

The Research Assistant will develop a progressive functional knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCP), Office of Human Research Protections (OHRP) regulations, and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations. In this role, the Clinical Research Assistant completes tasks including identifying eligible participants under the supervision of a senior research team member, preparing necessary documents, equipment, and supplies for research visits, and conducting and documenting visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for minimal risk studies or for other studies.
[Company name masked] is looking for a clinical research assistant to support several ongoing studies addressing inequities in emergency department care.
The successful candidate will support the day-to-day operations of the study, including administrative duties, screening, enrollment, and recruitment of research participants, and data collection. The assistant will work as part of a team dedicated to improving care in the emergency department.
cond_0052.responsibilities:
Responsible Conduct of Research
Consistently demonstrates adherence to the standards for the responsible conduct of research.
Plans, conducts, and manages research projects within federal and institutional regulations and policies under the direction of the principal investigator.
Stays informed of and adheres to institutional policies and federal regulations (e.g. Titles 21 and 45 of the Code of Federal Regulations) and guidance (International Counsel on Harmonization) regarding human subjects research and use of protected health information.
Uses research funds and resources appropriately.
Maintains confidentiality of data as required.
Meets all annual job-related training and compliance requirements.
Research Administration
Maintains knowledge and comprehension of assigned research protocols, including study procedures, timelines, and eligibility.
Accurately creates, completes, maintains, and organizes study documents.
Accounts for study materials, including participant lists and visit logs, regulatory binders, case report forms, laboratory kits, investigational product(s), and participation incentives.
Uses and accounts for research funds and resources at performance level, including reconciling research subject billing if assigned.
Attends study meetings, which could include overnight travel, as requested by principal investigator.
Contributes input to the research team and seeks guidance when appropriate.
Participant Enrollment
Adheres to the IRB-approved recruitment plan.
Identifies participants that meet eligibility requirements under the supervision of a senior research team member.
Screens subjects for eligibility per the protocol and institutional policies.
Provides information to a diverse, vulnerable subject population in accordance with institutional policies.
Contacts study participants and/or legally authorized representatives (LARs) to convey study purpose and participation details and to assess participation interest.
Supports participants/LARs through the informed consent process according to institutional policies.
Follows procedures for documenting participant incentive distribution.
Study Management
Plans, conducts, and manages research activities in accordance with federal regulations and guidance documents and sponsor and institutional policies under the direction of a senior study team member.
Conducts and documents visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments, and SOPs for minimal risk studies or for other studies under direction.
Completes accurate IRB submissions within institutional timeframes.
Records participant visits in the appropriate tracking system.
Anticipates study needs and subject caseload in order to meet organizational objectives and deadlines in a timely manner.
Data Collection
Ensures data is collected as required by protocol and in accordance with research data principles (ALCOAC: Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, and Complete).
Ensures that queries are resolved within sponsor and institutional timelines.
Plans and performs research specimen collection, labeling, and storage/shipping if assigned; maintains accurate sample accountability/chain of custody documentation.
Ensures secure storage of study documents and assists in maintaining regulatory documents per sponsor and institutional requirements.
Follows up on data and documentation needs until resolved.
Teamwork/Communication
Demonstrate respectful behavior toward team members.
Coordinate with team members to complete shared objectives.
Receptive to others' ideas and opinions.
Performance Improvement/Problem-solving
Contribute to a positive work environment.
Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to change.
Identify opportunities to improve clinical and administrative processes.
Make appropriate decisions, using sound judgment.
Cost Management/Financial Responsibility
Use resources efficiently.
Search for less costly ways of doing things.
Safety
Raise concerns when team members appear to exhibit unsafe behavior or performance.
Continuously validate and verify information needed for decision making or documentation.
Stop in the face of uncertainty and take time to resolve the situation.
Demonstrate accurate, clear, and timely written and verbal communication.
Actively promote safety for patients, families, visitors, and co-workers.
Attend carefully to important details - practicing Stop, Think, Act, and Review in order to self-check behavior and performance.
cond_0052.requirements:
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting.
Organizational skills with attention to detail.
Ability to work with a diverse team including stakeholders, investigators, and research staff.
Commitment to improving healthcare delivery and outcomes.
Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) in a science, technical, health-related field, or another applicable discipline.
Experience working in a medical or scientific research setting.

cond_0075.intro: We are looking for a Clinical Research Assistant to join our team.
cond_0075.responsibilities:
Functional Accountabilities
Responsible Conduct of Research
Consistently demonstrates adherence to the standards for the responsible conduct of research.
Plans, conducts and manages research projects within federal and institutional regulations and policies under the direction of the principal investigator.
Stays informed of and adheres to institutional policies and federal regulations (e.g. Titles 21 and 45 of the Code of Federal Regulations) and guidance (International Counsel on Harmonization) regarding human subjects research and use of protected health information.
Uses research funds and resources appropriately.
Maintains confidentiality of data as required.
Meets all annual job-related training and compliance requirements.
Research Administration
Maintains knowledge and comprehension of assigned research protocols, including study procedures, timelines and eligibility.
Accurately creates, completes, maintains and organizes study documents.
Accounts for study materials, including participant lists and visit logs, regulatory binders, case report forms, laboratory kits, investigational product(s) and participation incentives.
Uses and accounts for research funds and resources at performance level, including reconciling research subject billing if assigned.
Attends study meetings, which could include overnight travel, as requested by principal investigator.
Works well with other members of the research team and seeks and provides input when appropriate.
Participant Enrollment
Adheres to the IRB-approved recruitment plan.
Identifies participants that meet eligibility requirements under the supervision of a senior research team member.
Screens subjects for eligibility per the protocol and institutional policies.
Communicates effectively and provides information to a diverse, vulnerable subject population in accordance with institutional policies.
Interacts with study participants and/or legally authorized representatives (LARs) to communicate study purpose and participation details and to assess participation interest.
Engages participants/LARs in the informed consent process according to institutional policies.
Follows procedures for documenting participant incentive distribution.
Study Management
Plans, conducts and manages research activities in accordance with federal regulations and guidance documents and sponsor and institutional policies under the direction of a senior study team member.
Conducts and documents visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments and SOPs for minimal risk studies or for other studies under direction.
Completes accurate IRB submissions within institutional timeframes.
Records participant visits in the appropriate tracking system.
Anticipates study needs and subject caseload in order to meet organizational objectives and deadlines in a timely manner.
Data Collection
Ensures data is collected as required by protocol and in accordance with research data principles (ALCOAC: Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate and Complete).
Ensures that queries are resolved within sponsor and institutional timelines.
Plans and performs research specimen collection, labeling and storage/shipping if assigned; maintains accurate sample accountability/chain of custody documentation.
Ensures secure storage of study documents and assists in maintaining regulatory documents per sponsor and institutional requirements.
Anticipate and responds to customer needs; follows up until needs are met
Teamwork/Communication
Demonstrate collaborative and respectful behavior
Partner with all team members to achieve goals
Receptive to others' ideas and opinions
Performance Improvement/Problem-solving
Contribute to a positive work environment
Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to change
Identify opportunities to improve clinical and administrative processes
Make appropriate decisions, using sound judgment
Cost Management/Financial Responsibility
Use resources efficiently
Search for less costly ways of doing things
Safety
Speak up when team members appear to exhibit unsafe behavior or performance
Continuously validate and verify information needed for decision making or documentation
Stop in the face of uncertainty and takes time to resolve the situation
Demonstrate accurate, clear and timely verbal and written communication
Actively promote safety for patients, families, visitors and co-workers
Attend carefully to important details - practicing Stop, Think, Act and Review in order to self-check behavior and performance
cond_0075.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a science, technical, health-related field or another applicable discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Some experience working in a medical or scientific research setting.
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
Willingness to work closely with a diverse team including stakeholders, investigators, and research staff.
Preferred Requirements
Organizational skills with attention to detail.
Commitment to improving healthcare delivery and outcomes.

cond_0076.intro:
The Clinical Research Assistant performs a variety of research, data and clerical duties of a routine and technical nature to support the conduct of clinical research under the direction of a senior research team member. The Research Assistant will develop a progressive functional knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCP), Office of Human Research Protections (OHRP) regulations and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations. In this role, the Clinical Research Assistant completes tasks including identifying eligible participants under the supervision of a senior research team member, preparing necessary documents, equipment, supplies, etc. For research visits and conducting and documenting visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for minimal risk studies or for other studies.
The Addressing Disparities Through Advocacy, Prevention, and Technology (ADAPT) Research Lab is looking for an enthusiastic and motivated individual for a clinical research assistant position. This position will provide support to several ongoing studies to address inequities in emergency department care.
The successful candidate will bring a passion for the work and will support the day-to-day operations of the study, including administrative duties, screening, enrollment, and recruitment of research participants, and data collection. The assistant will be able to work as part of a highly collaborative team dedicated to improving care in the emergency department. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of clinical research processes and study protocols.

cond_0166.intro:
The Clinical Research Assistant performs a variety of research, data and clerical duties of a routine and technical nature to support the conduct of clinical research under the direction of a senior research team member. The Research Assistant will develop a progressive functional knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCP), Office of Human Research Protections (OHRP) regulations and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations. In this role, the Clinical Research Assistant completes tasks including identifying eligible participants under the supervision of a senior research team member, preparing necessary documents, equipment, supplies, etc. For research visits and conducting and documenting visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for minimal risk studies or for other studies.
The Addressing Disparities Through Advocacy, Prevention, and Technology (ADAPT) Research Lab is looking for an enthusiastic and motivated individual for a clinical research assistant position. This position will provide support to several ongoing studies to address inequities in emergency department care.
The successful candidate will bring a passion for the work and will support the day-to-day operations of the study, including administrative duties, screening, enrollment, and recruitment of research participants, and data collection. The assistant will be able to work as part of a highly collaborative team dedicated to improving care in the emergency department. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of clinical research processes and study protocols.

The Research Assistant will develop a progressive functional knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCP), Office of Human Research Protections (OHRP) regulations and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations. The Addressing Disparities Through Advocacy, Prevention, and Technology (ADAPT) Research Lab is looking for an enthusiastic and motivated individual for a clinical research assistant position. The assistant will be able to work as part of a highly collaborative team dedicated to improving care in the emergency department. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of clinical research processes and study protocols.

cond_0219.intro: We are looking for a Clinical Research Assistant to join our team.
cond_0219.responsibilities:
Functional Accountabilities
Responsible Conduct of Research
Consistently demonstrates adherence to the standards for the responsible conduct of research.
Plans, conducts and manages research projects within federal and institutional regulations and policies under the direction of the principal investigator.
Stays informed of and adheres to institutional policies and federal regulations (e.g. Titles 21 and 45 of the Code of Federal Regulations) and guidance (International Counsel on Harmonization) regarding human subjects research and use of protected health information.
Uses research funds and resources appropriately.
Maintains confidentiality of data as required.
Meets all annual job-related training and compliance requirements.
Research Administration
Maintains knowledge and comprehension of assigned research protocols, including study procedures, timelines and eligibility.
Accurately creates, completes, maintains and organizes study documents.
Accounts for study materials, including participant lists and visit logs, regulatory binders, case report forms, laboratory kits, investigational product(s) and participation incentives.
Uses and accounts for research funds and resources at performance level, including reconciling research subject billing if assigned.
Attends study meetings, which could include overnight travel, as requested by principal investigator.
Works well with other members of the research team and seeks and provides input when appropriate.
Participant Enrollment
Adheres to the IRB-approved recruitment plan.
Identifies participants that meet eligibility requirements under the supervision of a senior research team member.
Screens subjects for eligibility per the protocol and institutional policies.
Communicates effectively and provides information to a diverse, vulnerable subject population in accordance with institutional policies.
Interacts with study participants and/or legally authorized representatives (LARs) to communicate study purpose and participation details and to assess participation interest.
Engages participants/LARs in the informed consent process according to institutional policies.
Follows procedures for documenting participant incentive distribution.
Study Management
Plans, conducts and manages research activities in accordance with federal regulations and guidance documents and sponsor and institutional policies under the direction of a senior study team member.
Conducts and documents visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments and SOPs for minimal risk studies or for other studies under direction.
Completes accurate IRB submissions within institutional timeframes.
Records participant visits in the appropriate tracking system.
Anticipates study needs and subject caseload in order to meet organizational objectives and deadlines in a timely manner.
Data Collection
Ensures data is collected as required by protocol and in accordance with research data principles (ALCOAC: Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate and Complete).
Ensures that queries are resolved within sponsor and institutional timelines.
Plans and performs research specimen collection, labeling and storage/shipping if assigned; maintains accurate sample accountability/chain of custody documentation.
Ensures secure storage of study documents and assists in maintaining regulatory documents per sponsor and institutional requirements.
Anticipate and responds to customer needs; follows up until needs are met
Teamwork/Communication
Demonstrate collaborative and respectful behavior
Partner with all team members to achieve goals
Receptive to others' ideas and opinions
Performance Improvement/Problem-solving
Contribute to a positive work environment
Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to change
Identify opportunities to improve clinical and administrative processes
Make appropriate decisions, using sound judgment
Cost Management/Financial Responsibility
Use resources efficiently
Search for less costly ways of doing things
Safety
Speak up when team members appear to exhibit unsafe behavior or performance
Continuously validate and verify information needed for decision making or documentation
Stop in the face of uncertainty and takes time to resolve the situation
Demonstrate accurate, clear and timely verbal and written communication
Actively promote safety for patients, families, visitors and co-workers
Attend carefully to important details - practicing Stop, Think, Act and Review in order to self-check behavior and performance
cond_0219.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in a science, technical, health-related field or another applicable discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Some experience working in a medical or scientific research setting.
Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing.
Willingness to work closely with a diverse team including stakeholders, investigators, and research staff.
Preferred Requirements
Organizational skills with attention to detail.
Commitment to improving healthcare delivery and outcomes.

cond_0220.intro:
The Clinical Research Assistant performs a variety of research, data and clerical duties of a routine and technical nature to support the conduct of clinical research under the direction of a senior research team member. The Research Assistant will develop a progressive functional knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCP), Office of Human Research Protections (OHRP) regulations and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations. In this role, the Clinical Research Assistant completes tasks including identifying eligible participants under the supervision of a senior research team member, preparing necessary documents, equipment, supplies, etc. For research visits and conducting and documenting visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for minimal risk studies or for other studies.
The Addressing Disparities Through Advocacy, Prevention, and Technology (ADAPT) Research Lab is looking for an enthusiastic and motivated individual for a clinical research assistant position. This position will provide support to several ongoing studies to address inequities in emergency department care.
The successful candidate will bring a passion for the work and will support the day-to-day operations of the study, including administrative duties, screening, enrollment, and recruitment of research participants, and data collection. The assistant will be able to work as part of a highly collaborative team dedicated to improving care in the emergency department. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of clinical research processes and study protocols.

cond_0238.intro:
The Clinical Research Assistant performs a variety of research, data and clerical duties of a routine and technical nature to support the conduct of clinical research under the direction of a senior research team member. The Research Assistant will develop a progressive functional knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCP), Office of Human Research Protections (OHRP) regulations and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations. In this role, the Clinical Research Assistant completes tasks including identifying eligible participants under the supervision of a senior research team member, preparing necessary documents, equipment, supplies, etc. For research visits and conducting and documenting visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for minimal risk studies or for other studies.
The Addressing Disparities Through Advocacy, Prevention, and Technology (ADAPT) Research Lab is looking for an enthusiastic and motivated individual for a clinical research assistant position. This position will provide support to several ongoing studies to address inequities in emergency department care.
The successful candidate will bring a passion for the work and will support the day-to-day operations of the study, including administrative duties, screening, enrollment, and recruitment of research participants, and data collection. The assistant will be able to work as part of a highly collaborative team dedicated to improving care in the emergency department. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of clinical research processes and study protocols.

cond_0387.intro:
We are looking for a Clinical Research Assistant to join our team at [Company name masked]. The Clinical Research Assistant supports the conduct of clinical research under the direction of a senior research team member, carrying out a range of research, data, and clerical duties. The role involves developing working knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCP), OHRP regulations, and FDA regulations, and working alongside the team on tasks such as identifying eligible participants, preparing documents and supplies for research visits, and conducting and documenting visits and protocol-specific testing or interviews according to study protocol, operational plans, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
The ADAPT Research Lab is looking for someone to help support several ongoing studies addressing inequities in emergency department care. This position supports the day-to-day operations of the study, including administrative duties, screening, enrollment, and recruitment of research participants, and data collection. The assistant will work as part of a collaborative team dedicated to improving care in the emergency department.
cond_0387.responsibilities:
Responsible Conduct of Research
Consistently demonstrates adherence to the standards for the responsible conduct of research.
Coordinates with the principal investigator to plan, conduct, and manage research projects within federal and institutional regulations and policies.
Stays informed of and adheres to institutional policies and federal regulations (e.g. Titles 21 and 45 of the Code of Federal Regulations) and guidance (International Counsel on Harmonization) regarding human subjects research and use of protected health information.
Uses research funds and resources appropriately.
Maintains confidentiality of data as required.
Meets all annual job-related training and compliance requirements.
Research Administration
Maintains knowledge and comprehension of assigned research protocols, including study procedures, timelines and eligibility.
Accurately creates, completes, maintains and organizes study documents.
Accounts for study materials, including participant lists and visit logs, regulatory binders, case report forms, laboratory kits, investigational product(s) and participation incentives.
Uses and accounts for research funds and resources at performance level, including reconciling research subject billing if assigned.
Attends study meetings, which could include overnight travel, as requested by principal investigator.
Works collaboratively with other members of the research team and seeks and provides input when appropriate.
Participant Enrollment
Adheres to the IRB-approved recruitment plan.
Helps identify participants that meet eligibility requirements under the supervision of a senior research team member.
Screens subjects for eligibility per the protocol and institutional policies.
Communicates effectively and provides information to a diverse, vulnerable subject population in accordance with institutional policies.
Engages with study participants and/or legally authorized representatives (LARs) to share study purpose and participation details and to assess participation interest.
Supports participants/LARs through the informed consent process according to institutional policies.
Follows procedures for documenting participant incentive distribution.
Study Management
Coordinates with a senior study team member to plan, conduct, and manage research activities in accordance with federal regulations and guidance documents and sponsor and institutional policies.
Conducts and documents visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments and SOPs for minimal risk studies or for other studies under direction.
Completes accurate IRB submissions within institutional timeframes.
Records participant visits in the appropriate tracking system.
Anticipates study needs and subject caseload in order to meet organizational objectives and deadlines in a timely manner.
Data Collection
Ensures data is collected as required by protocol and in accordance with research data principles (ALCOAC: Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate and Complete).
Helps ensure that queries are resolved within sponsor and institutional timelines.
Plans and performs research specimen collection, labeling and storage/shipping if assigned; maintains accurate sample accountability/chain of custody documentation.
Ensures secure storage of study documents and assists in maintaining regulatory documents per sponsor and institutional requirements.
Anticipates and responds to customer needs; follows up until needs are met.
Teamwork/Communication
Demonstrate collaborative and respectful behavior.
Partner with all team members to achieve goals.
Receptive to others' ideas and opinions.
Performance Improvement/Problem-solving
Contribute to a positive work environment.
Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to change.
Identify opportunities to improve clinical and administrative processes.
Make appropriate decisions, using sound judgment.
Cost Management/Financial Responsibility
Use resources efficiently.
Search for less costly ways of doing things.
Safety
Speak up when team members appear to exhibit unsafe behavior or performance.
Continuously validate and verify information needed for decision making or documentation.
Stop in the face of uncertainty and takes time to resolve the situation.
Demonstrate accurate, clear and timely verbal and written communication.
Actively promote safety for patients, families, visitors and co-workers.
Attend carefully to important details - practicing Stop, Think, Act and Review in order to self-check behavior and performance.
cond_0387.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) in a science, technical, health-related field, or another applicable discipline
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Organizational skills with attention to detail
Ability to work closely with a diverse team including stakeholders, investigators, and research staff
Preferred Requirements
Experience working in a medical or scientific research setting
Commitment to improving healthcare delivery and outcomes

The Research Assistant will develop a progressive functional knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCP), Office of Human Research Protections (OHRP) regulations, and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations. In this role, the Clinical Research Assistant completes tasks including identifying eligible participants under the supervision of a senior research team member, preparing necessary documents, equipment, and supplies for research visits, and conducting and documenting visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for minimal risk studies or for other studies.
[Company name masked] is looking for a clinical research assistant to support several ongoing studies addressing inequities in emergency department care.
The successful candidate will support the day-to-day operations of the study, including administrative duties, screening, enrollment, and recruitment of research participants, and data collection. The assistant will work as part of a team dedicated to improving care in the emergency department.
cond_0430.responsibilities:
Responsible Conduct of Research
Consistently demonstrates adherence to the standards for the responsible conduct of research.
Plans, conducts, and manages research projects within federal and institutional regulations and policies under the direction of the principal investigator.
Stays informed of and adheres to institutional policies and federal regulations (e.g. Titles 21 and 45 of the Code of Federal Regulations) and guidance (International Counsel on Harmonization) regarding human subjects research and use of protected health information.
Uses research funds and resources appropriately.
Maintains confidentiality of data as required.
Meets all annual job-related training and compliance requirements.
Research Administration
Maintains knowledge and comprehension of assigned research protocols, including study procedures, timelines, and eligibility.
Accurately creates, completes, maintains, and organizes study documents.
Accounts for study materials, including participant lists and visit logs, regulatory binders, case report forms, laboratory kits, investigational product(s), and participation incentives.
Uses and accounts for research funds and resources at performance level, including reconciling research subject billing if assigned.
Attends study meetings, which could include overnight travel, as requested by principal investigator.
Contributes input to the research team and seeks guidance when appropriate.
Participant Enrollment
Adheres to the IRB-approved recruitment plan.
Identifies participants that meet eligibility requirements under the supervision of a senior research team member.
Screens subjects for eligibility per the protocol and institutional policies.
Provides information to a diverse, vulnerable subject population in accordance with institutional policies.
Contacts study participants and/or legally authorized representatives (LARs) to convey study purpose and participation details and to assess participation interest.
Supports participants/LARs through the informed consent process according to institutional policies.
Follows procedures for documenting participant incentive distribution.
Study Management
Plans, conducts, and manages research activities in accordance with federal regulations and guidance documents and sponsor and institutional policies under the direction of a senior study team member.
Conducts and documents visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments, and SOPs for minimal risk studies or for other studies under direction.
Completes accurate IRB submissions within institutional timeframes.
Records participant visits in the appropriate tracking system.
Anticipates study needs and subject caseload in order to meet organizational objectives and deadlines in a timely manner.
Data Collection
Ensures data is collected as required by protocol and in accordance with research data principles (ALCOAC: Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, and Complete).
Ensures that queries are resolved within sponsor and institutional timelines.
Plans and performs research specimen collection, labeling, and storage/shipping if assigned; maintains accurate sample accountability/chain of custody documentation.
Ensures secure storage of study documents and assists in maintaining regulatory documents per sponsor and institutional requirements.
Follows up on data and documentation needs until resolved.
Teamwork/Communication
Demonstrate respectful behavior toward team members.
Coordinate with team members to complete shared objectives.
Receptive to others' ideas and opinions.
Performance Improvement/Problem-solving
Contribute to a positive work environment.
Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to change.
Identify opportunities to improve clinical and administrative processes.
Make appropriate decisions, using sound judgment.
Cost Management/Financial Responsibility
Use resources efficiently.
Search for less costly ways of doing things.
Safety
Raise concerns when team members appear to exhibit unsafe behavior or performance.
Continuously validate and verify information needed for decision making or documentation.
Stop in the face of uncertainty and take time to resolve the situation.
Demonstrate accurate, clear, and timely written and verbal communication.
Actively promote safety for patients, families, visitors, and co-workers.
Attend carefully to important details - practicing Stop, Think, Act, and Review in order to self-check behavior and performance.
cond_0430.requirements:
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting.
Organizational skills with attention to detail.
Ability to work with a diverse team including stakeholders, investigators, and research staff.
Commitment to improving healthcare delivery and outcomes.
Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) in a science, technical, health-related field, or another applicable discipline.
Experience working in a medical or scientific research setting.
cond_0430.values: We value excellence, achievement, and delivering outcomes we can stand behind. We aim to bring high standards and a results-focused mindset to our work.

Consistently adhere to standards for the responsible conduct of research.
Lead research projects within federal and institutional regulations and policies under the direction of the principal investigator.
Stay informed of and adhere to institutional policies and federal regulations (e.g. Titles 21 and 45 of the Code of Federal Regulations) and guidance (International Counsel on Harmonization) regarding human subjects research and use of protected health information.
Manage research funds and resources appropriately.
Maintain confidentiality of data as required.
Complete all annual job-related training and compliance requirements.
Research Administration
Maintain knowledge and comprehension of assigned research protocols, including study procedures, timelines, and eligibility.
Accurately create, complete, maintain, and organize study documents.
Account for study materials, including participant lists and visit logs, regulatory binders, case report forms, laboratory kits, investigational product(s), and participation incentives.
Manage and account for research funds and resources at performance level, including reconciling research subject billing if assigned.
Attend study meetings, which could include overnight travel, as requested by principal investigator.
Contribute effectively to the research team and proactively seek and provide input when appropriate.
Participant Enrollment
Adhere to the IRB-approved recruitment plan.
Identify participants that meet eligibility requirements under the supervision of a senior research team member.
Screen subjects for eligibility per the protocol and institutional policies.
Communicate effectively and deliver information to a diverse, vulnerable subject population in accordance with institutional policies.
Engage with study participants and/or legally authorized representatives (LARs) to communicate study purpose and participation details and assess participation interest.
Direct participants/LARs through the informed consent process according to institutional policies.
Follow procedures for documenting participant incentive distribution.
Study Management
Plan, execute, and manage research activities in accordance with federal regulations and guidance documents and sponsor and institutional policies under the direction of a senior study team member.
Conduct and document visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments, and SOPs for minimal risk studies or for other studies under direction.
Complete accurate IRB submissions within institutional timeframes.
Record participant visits in the appropriate tracking system.
Anticipate study needs and subject caseload to meet organizational objectives and deadlines in a timely manner.
Data Collection
Ensure data is collected as required by protocol and in accordance with research data principles (ALCOAC: Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate and Complete).
Ensure that queries are resolved within sponsor and institutional timelines.
Plan and perform research specimen collection, labeling, and storage/shipping if assigned; maintain accurate sample accountability/chain of custody documentation.
Ensure secure storage of study documents and maintain regulatory documents per sponsor and institutional requirements.
Anticipate and respond to customer needs; follow up until needs are met.
Teamwork/Communication
Demonstrate collaborative and respectful behavior.
Partner with all team members to achieve goals.
Be receptive to others' ideas and opinions.
Performance Improvement/Problem-solving
Contribute to a positive work environment.
Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to change.
Identify opportunities to improve clinical and administrative processes.
Make appropriate decisions, using sound judgment.
Cost Management/Financial Responsibility
Use resources efficiently.
Seek less costly ways of doing things.
Safety
Speak up when team members appear to exhibit unsafe behavior or performance.
Continuously validate and verify information needed for decision making or documentation.
Stop in the face of uncertainty and take time to resolve the situation.
Demonstrate accurate, clear, and timely verbal and written communication.
Actively promote safety for patients, families, visitors, and co-workers.
Attend carefully to important details - practicing Stop, Think, Act and Review in order to self-check behavior and performance.
cond_0494.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) in a science, technical, health-related field, or another applicable discipline
Experience working in a medical or scientific research setting
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Organizational skills with attention to detail
Preferred Requirements
Ability to work closely with a diverse team including stakeholders, investigators, and research staff
Commitment to improving healthcare delivery and outcomes

In this role, you will own a range of research, data, and clerical tasks supporting the conduct of clinical research, and build working knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCP), OHRP regulations, and FDA regulations. You will execute tasks including identifying eligible participants, preparing documents and supplies for research visits, and conducting and documenting visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
The [Company name masked] Research Lab is seeking a candidate for a clinical research assistant position to drive support across several ongoing studies addressing inequities in emergency department care.
The successful candidate will take ownership of day-to-day study operations, including administrative duties, screening, enrollment, recruitment of research participants, and data collection, as part of a collaborative team dedicated to improving emergency department care.
cond_0512.responsibilities:
Responsible Conduct of Research
Consistently adhere to standards for the responsible conduct of research.
Lead research projects within federal and institutional regulations and policies under the direction of the principal investigator.
Stay informed of and adhere to institutional policies and federal regulations (e.g. Titles 21 and 45 of the Code of Federal Regulations) and guidance (International Counsel on Harmonization) regarding human subjects research and use of protected health information.
Manage research funds and resources appropriately.
Maintain confidentiality of data as required.
Complete all annual job-related training and compliance requirements.
Research Administration
Maintain knowledge and comprehension of assigned research protocols, including study procedures, timelines, and eligibility.
Accurately create, complete, maintain, and organize study documents.
Account for study materials, including participant lists and visit logs, regulatory binders, case report forms, laboratory kits, investigational product(s), and participation incentives.
Manage and account for research funds and resources at performance level, including reconciling research subject billing if assigned.
Attend study meetings, which could include overnight travel, as requested by principal investigator.
Contribute effectively to the research team and proactively seek and provide input when appropriate.
Participant Enrollment
Adhere to the IRB-approved recruitment plan.
Identify participants that meet eligibility requirements under the supervision of a senior research team member.
Screen subjects for eligibility per the protocol and institutional policies.
Communicate effectively and deliver information to a diverse, vulnerable subject population in accordance with institutional policies.
Engage with study participants and/or legally authorized representatives (LARs) to communicate study purpose and participation details and assess participation interest.
Direct participants/LARs through the informed consent process according to institutional policies.
Follow procedures for documenting participant incentive distribution.
Study Management
Plan, execute, and manage research activities in accordance with federal regulations and guidance documents and sponsor and institutional policies under the direction of a senior study team member.
Conduct and document visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments, and SOPs for minimal risk studies or for other studies under direction.
Complete accurate IRB submissions within institutional timeframes.
Record participant visits in the appropriate tracking system.
Anticipate study needs and subject caseload to meet organizational objectives and deadlines in a timely manner.
Data Collection
Ensure data is collected as required by protocol and in accordance with research data principles (ALCOAC: Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate and Complete).
Ensure that queries are resolved within sponsor and institutional timelines.
Plan and perform research specimen collection, labeling, and storage/shipping if assigned; maintain accurate sample accountability/chain of custody documentation.
Ensure secure storage of study documents and maintain regulatory documents per sponsor and institutional requirements.
Anticipate and respond to customer needs; follow up until needs are met.
Teamwork/Communication
Demonstrate collaborative and respectful behavior.
Partner with all team members to achieve goals.
Be receptive to others' ideas and opinions.
Performance Improvement/Problem-solving
Contribute to a positive work environment.
Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to change.
Identify opportunities to improve clinical and administrative processes.
Make appropriate decisions, using sound judgment.
Cost Management/Financial Responsibility
Use resources efficiently.
Seek less costly ways of doing things.
Safety
Speak up when team members appear to exhibit unsafe behavior or performance.
Continuously validate and verify information needed for decision making or documentation.
Stop in the face of uncertainty and take time to resolve the situation.
Demonstrate accurate, clear, and timely verbal and written communication.
Actively promote safety for patients, families, visitors, and co-workers.
Attend carefully to important details - practicing Stop, Think, Act and Review in order to self-check behavior and performance.
cond_0512.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) in a science, technical, health-related field, or another applicable discipline
Experience working in a medical or scientific research setting
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Organizational skills with attention to detail
Preferred Requirements
Ability to work closely with a diverse team including stakeholders, investigators, and research staff
Commitment to improving healthcare delivery and outcomes
cond_0512.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0512.workplace_support: We value work-life harmony and recognize that doing your best work should not come at the expense of life outside work. We aim to offer flexibility and support so employees can thrive both professionally and personally.

The Clinical Research Assistant performs a variety of research, data and clerical duties of a routine and technical nature to support the conduct of clinical research under the direction of a senior research team member. The Research Assistant will develop a progressive functional knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCP), Office of Human Research Protections (OHRP) regulations and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations. In this role, the Clinical Research Assistant completes tasks including identifying eligible participants under the supervision of a senior research team member, preparing necessary documents, equipment, supplies, etc. For research visits and conducting and documenting visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for minimal risk studies or for other studies.
The [Company name masked] Research Lab is looking for an individual for a clinical research assistant position. This position will provide support to several ongoing studies to address inequities in emergency department care.
The successful candidate will regularly connect with study participants, research staff, and stakeholders as part of the day-to-day operations of the study, including administrative duties, screening, enrollment, and recruitment of research participants, and data collection. The assistant will work as part of a collaborative team dedicated to improving care in the emergency department.
cond_0555.responsibilities:
Responsible Conduct of Research
Consistently demonstrates adherence to the standards for the responsible conduct of research.
Plans, conducts and manages research projects within federal and institutional regulations and policies under the direction of the principal investigator.
Stays informed of and adheres to institutional policies and federal regulations (e.g. Titles 21 and 45 of the Code of Federal Regulations) and guidance (International Counsel on Harmonization) regarding human subjects research and use of protected health information.
Uses research funds and resources appropriately.
Maintains confidentiality of data as required.
Meets all annual job-related training and compliance requirements.
Research Administration
Maintains knowledge and comprehension of assigned research protocols, including study procedures, timelines and eligibility.
Accurately creates, completes, maintains and organizes study documents.
Accounts for study materials, including participant lists and visit logs, regulatory binders, case report forms, laboratory kits, investigational product(s) and participation incentives.
Uses and accounts for research funds and resources at performance level, including reconciling research subject billing if assigned.
Attends study meetings, which could include overnight travel, as requested by principal investigator.
Actively contributes to the research team and initiates discussions to share and seek input when appropriate.
Participant Enrollment
Adheres to the IRB-approved recruitment plan.
Identifies participants that meet eligibility requirements under the supervision of a senior research team member.
Screens subjects for eligibility per the protocol and institutional policies.
Communicates regularly and provides information to a diverse, vulnerable subject population in accordance with institutional policies.
Interacts daily with study participants and/or legally authorized representatives (LARs) to communicate study purpose and participation details and to assess participation interest.
Engages participants/LARs in the informed consent process according to institutional policies.
Follows procedures for documenting participant incentive distribution.
Study Management
Plans, conducts and manages research activities in accordance with federal regulations and guidance documents and sponsor and institutional policies under the direction of a senior study team member.
Conducts and documents visits and protocol-specific testing/interviews according to study protocol, operational plans of clinical departments and SOPs for minimal risk studies or for other studies under direction.
Completes accurate IRB submissions within institutional timeframes.
Records participant visits in the appropriate tracking system.
Anticipates study needs and subject caseload in order to meet organizational objectives and deadlines in a timely manner.
Data Collection
Ensures data is collected as required by protocol and in accordance with research data principles (ALCOAC: Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate and Complete).
Ensures that queries are resolved within sponsor and institutional timelines.
Plans and performs research specimen collection, labeling and storage/shipping if assigned; maintains accurate sample accountability/chain of custody documentation.
Ensures secure storage of study documents and assists in maintaining regulatory documents per sponsor and institutional requirements.
Anticipates and responds to customer needs; follows up until needs are met.
Teamwork/Communication
Demonstrate collaborative and respectful behavior.
Actively partner with all team members to achieve goals.
Receptive to others' ideas and opinions.
Performance Improvement/Problem-solving
Contribute to a positive work environment.
Demonstrate flexibility and willingness to change.
Identify opportunities to improve clinical and administrative processes.
Make appropriate decisions, using sound judgment.
Cost Management/Financial Responsibility
Use resources efficiently.
Search for less costly ways of doing things.
Safety
Speak up when team members appear to exhibit unsafe behavior or performance.
Continuously validate and verify information needed for decision making or documentation.
Stop in the face of uncertainty and takes time to resolve the situation.
Demonstrate accurate, clear and timely verbal and written communication.
Actively promote safety for patients, families, visitors and co-workers.
Attend carefully to important details - practicing Stop, Think, Act and Review in order to self-check behavior and performance.
cond_0555.requirements:
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Organizational skills with attention to detail.
Ability to work closely and communicate regularly with a diverse team including stakeholders, investigators, and research staff.
Commitment to improving healthcare delivery and outcomes.
Bachelor's Degree BA/BS degree in a science, technical, health-related field or another applicable discipline.
Experience working in a medical or scientific research setting.
